title: A singly linked list
hints: `removeAll` is easiest with a pointer to the `unique_ptr` that links to the current node (`std::unique_ptr<Node>* link = &head_;`): removing is `*link = std::move((*link)->next);`, and moving on is `link = &(*link)->next;`. The last node you **keep** is the new tail.
After `reverse`, the old head is the new tail: remember `head_.get()` before you start.
